statutory_review.exact_text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle within an alley in such position as to block the driveway or entrance to any abutting property.
statutory_review.subject: person responsible for the vehicle's stopping, standing, or parking; target actor is a motor-vehicle driver
elements_to_establish: The subject vehicle is within an alley during the relevant halt interval.
A driveway or entrance serves property abutting that alley.
The person stops, stands, or parks the vehicle; record actual movement, dwell, purpose, and activity so these alternatives remain distinguishable.

The vehicle's actual position blocks that driveway or entrance during the halt. Blocking is a legal and physical judgment to review from recorded geometry and access evidence; no overlap or clearance threshold is adopted here.
statutory_review.timing: Assess the actual position throughout every stopped, standing, or parked interval; retain the full time history, not a single destination frame.
statutory_review.source_conflict_note: The recovered summary places blocking among activation conditions, but the exact clause also makes blocking the prohibited result. Case selection must not assume blocking from the planned halt position.

authored_world_setup: Construct a drivable alley segment with an abutting parcel and one vehicular driveway opening into the alley; identify the alley surface, parcel boundary, driveway mouth, and access route in the scene's coordinate frame.
Place the same qualifying motor vehicle and driver on an approach within the alley, with a clear approach and no other vehicle at the opening.
Keep alley geometry, driveway width, parcel, actor, vehicle dimensions, approach route, weather, lighting, camera placement, and other traffic identical across the two controlled cases.
Document the highway/alley status and the parcel's abutment and driveway function using authority beyond rendered appearance.
scene_proposal.controller_intention: Approach at low speed, brake to a destination halt within the alley, and request a five-second dwell; the actual stop and dwell must be measured, not inferred from the request.
scene_proposal.comparison_variable: Commanded longitudinal halt station along the same alley relative to the driveway mouth; measured vehicle position is the realized variable.
scene_proposal.rendering_goal: An overhead or oblique view shows the whole vehicle footprint and driveway mouth together, while a second approach view shows the alley context and entrance use.

native_observations_required.name: subject_pose_and_velocity
native_observations_required.source: Native actor transform and velocity each capture tick
native_observations_required.purpose: Locate the vehicle in the alley and establish actual approach, zero-motion interval, and departure.

native_observations_required.name: subject_footprint
native_observations_required.source: Native bounding box, orientation, and transform each capture tick
native_observations_required.purpose: Reconstruct the occupied ground footprint and its position relative to the mouth throughout the halt.

native_observations_required.name: alley_and_driveway_geometry
native_observations_required.source: Native road or OpenDRIVE geometry plus authored, surveyed parcel and entrance boundaries with provenance
native_observations_required.purpose: Locate the alley, abutting property, entrance opening, and potential access path in one frame.

native_observations_required.name: driveway_access_context
native_observations_required.source: Authored entrance use and ownership evidence, plus Native geometry and any observed access movements
native_observations_required.purpose: Support review of whether this is a qualifying driveway or entrance and whether access is blocked.

native_observations_required.name: halt_activity_and_directions
native_observations_required.source: Native actor and occupant events where available, time-synchronized video, and authored context for purpose, loading, passenger activity, traffic conflict, and official directions
native_observations_required.purpose: Keep stop, stand, and park alternatives and exceptional contextual claims reviewable without inferring intent from pose alone.

native_observations_required.name: synchronized_visual_record
native_observations_required.source: Native camera frames with timestamps and camera calibration
native_observations_required.purpose: Show vehicle, alley, property entrance, access corridor, and complete relevant interval; retain raw measurements for independent audit.

controlled_cases.fixed_facts: Use the scene_proposal fixed world setup and the same approach, vehicle, dwell request, and capture channels as the paired case.
controlled_cases.controller_target: Stop with the vehicle body centered across the driveway mouth and dwell for five seconds.
controlled_cases.measurement: Record the actual footprint, alley position, and driveway access geometry for the entire realized halt.
controlled_cases.hypothesis: Presents a candidate obstruction for later factual and legal review; no blocking verdict is assigned.

controlled_cases.deliberate_difference: Move only the commanded halt station to a point beyond the driveway mouth with room for the full measured vehicle footprint and access corridor; preserve the same alley, approach, driver, vehicle, activity, and five-second dwell request.
controlled_cases.measurement: Verify from the actual footprint and entrance geometry that the vehicle stayed in the alley and document access throughout the realized halt.
controlled_cases.hypothesis: Provides a candidate clear-access comparison; no compliance verdict is assigned.

unverified_facts_and_limits: The upstream coverage-witnesses.json file is absent locally; its declared hash and row index are carried from the frozen witness packet, not independently rehashed.
No proof yet that a CARLA map or authored OpenDRIVE construction contains a legally qualifying public alley and an abutting private driveway used by permitted vehicles.
Parcel ownership, highway dedication, public vehicular access, and the legal definitions of alley and driveway require external authority; simulation geometry alone cannot establish them.
The proposed vehicle and driveway dimensions, route connectivity, brake completion, five-second realized dwell, camera coverage, and Native data availability have not been tested.
Whether any measured position blocks access remains unresolved; no clearance, overlap, or duration threshold is invented.
The purposes and activities that distinguish stopping, standing, and parking, plus any official directions or conflicts, are not established by a static vehicle pose.
No CARLA execution, saved Native evidence, Core conversion, independent acceptance, or accepted recording is claimed.
